SECTION ONE
Purpose, Scope, Basis and Definitions
Purpose
ARTICLE 1 – (1) The purpose of this Regulation is to regulate the procedures and principles regarding
the objectives, areas of activity, governing bodies, duties and the ways of work of the governing bodies of
Gebze Technical University Smart Agriculture Application and Research Center.
Scope
ARTICLE 2 – (1) This Regulation covers the provisions regarding the objectives, areas of activity,
governing bodies, duties and the ways of work of the governing bodies of Gebze Technical University Smart
Agriculture Application and Research Center.
Basis
ARTICLE 3 – (1) This Regulation has been prepared based on subparagraph (2) of clause (d) of the
first paragraph of Article 7 and Article 14 of the Higher Education Law No. 2547 dated 4/11/1981.
Definitions
ARTICLE 4 – (1) In this Regulation, the following terms have the following definitions:
a) Center: Gebze Technical University Smart Agriculture Application and Research Center
b) Director: Director of the Center
c) Rector: Rector of Gebze Technical University
d) University: Gebze Technical University
d) Executive Board: Executive Board of the Center
SECTION TWO
Objectives and Areas of Activity of the Center
Objectives of the Center
ARTICLE 5 – (1) The objectives of the center are as follows:
a) To establish and operate all kinds of infrastructure that will provide the necessary support for research
in the field of smart agriculture
b) To encourage and support all kinds of scientific and technical applications and research regarding
smart agriculture within the framework of the relevant legislation and to ensure that public and private
organizations and other interested parties benefi t from them, and to provide consultancy services on issues
within its field upon the request of these organizations
c) To encourage the training of staff at the university who will conduct applications and research in this
field, to support these people, and to provide the necessary coordination in the research to be carried out in
this field
d) To cooperate with local and foreign organizations for applications and research in this field
e) To organize seminars, courses , and conferences in order to encourage applications and research in
this field and to announce the research carried out, and to issue certificates regarding these when necessary
f) To encourage and realize all kinds of publications in this field and to make all kinds of investments
to establish a library containing source publications
Areas of Activity of the Center
ARTICLE 6 – (1) The areas of activity of the Center are as follows:
a) To carry out research, development, and application activities on agricultural farm management

b) To carry out R&D activities on the development of all kinds of hardware and software for s mart
agriculture and production
c) To carry out research, development , and application activities in the fields of smart agriculture and
plant tissue culture production of high value-added medicinal and aromatic plants used in the pharmaceutical,
cosmetic and textile industries, and their promotion to regional farmers
d) To carry out activities on the conservation and identification of the region's biodiversity resources
and their production through smart agriculture and/or plant tissue culture, and to conduct research on
diversifying the agricultural production pattern
e) To conduct research on the use of molecular markers to determine plant diversity, to produce high -
yield plant species, and to preserve them in medium and long terms
f) To carry out research and development studies in different fields, especially product development,
production, processing, and evaluation of products, food safety and health, and to support the studies carried
out
g) To market or offer for consumption the produced plant products by passing them through
technological processes, if needed, and to establish and operate plant production centers or have them operated
for this purpose
h) To carry out publishing activities in order to inform the public about the research and applications
carried out within the Center
i) To enable all kinds of publications in line with the aims of the center, to prepare and provide films,
videos, cassettes, slides, books, magazines, newspapers, and similar materials that may be used as publication
materials in agriculture and to make use of mass media for this purpose
j) To make production plans in the areas of the university suitable for agricultural production, to carry
out all kinds of crop production by using the existing natural resources, capital and labor force in the areas
allocated for production and/or rented, if necessary, in line with the prepared plans, and to produce agricultural
products for the province and region in land and greenhouses by following scientific and technological
innovations. To contribute to the production of economically valuable and promising plant varieties, especially
through smart agriculture, and to organize activities such as storage, processing, and packaging of agricultural
products
k) To carry out research and development studies on the production of products that support plant growth
such as organomineral and microbial fertilizers to be used in agricultural production, to develop products, to
market the developed products, and to offer them for consumption
l) To ensure that the information and results obtained from research or other activities are transformed
into scientific publications and published
m) To receive projects from the public, private sector , and other institutions within the framework of
the relevant legislation on issues related to its fields of activity and to implement these projects
n) To organize courses, seminars, conferences, congresses , and similar meetings on subjects related to
the center's area of activity, to issue certificates, and to make publications regarding its activities
o) To cooperate with public institutions and organizations, private sector, non -governmental
organizations and international organizations within the framework of the relevant legislation in order to
realize the objectives of the center
p) To organize various organizations such as meetings, seminars , and trips to introduce smart
agricultural applications to students and the society
r) To carry out chemical, physical, and microbiological tests on foods, to have them done and to report
them
s) Within the framework of the relevant legislation, to carry out joint projects with public institutions
and organizations and private companies, to market the developed hardware and/or software pro duct, and to
offer it to farmers
t) To carry out research, development , and application activities on the extraction of extracts of plant
products produced by smart agriculture and/or plant tissue culture

SECTION THREE
Governing Bodies and Duties of the Center
Governing Bodies of the Center
ARTICLE 7 – (1) The governing bodies of the center are:
a) Director
b) Executive Board
c) Advisory Board
Director
ARTICLE 8 – (1) The Director is a ssigned by the Rector for three years from among the faculty
members working at the University related to the area of activity of the Center. The Director whose term has
expired may be reassigned.
(2) In order to assist the D irector in his /her work, a maximum of two people from among the faculty
members working at the University related to the area of activity of the Center may be assigned as deputy
directors by the Rector. Deputy directors may be replaced when necessary, using the same procedure.
(3) When the Director is not on duty, one of the deputy directors acts in his/her place. If the mandate
lasts more than six months, a new Director is assigned. When the duty of the director ends, the duties of the
deputy directors also end.
(4) The Director reports to the Rector for the regular execution of the work in line with the objectives
of the Center, for the supervision , and control of all activities of the Center, and for taking the necessary
measures in these matters.
Duties of the Director
ARTICLE 9 – (1) The duties of the Director are as follows:
a) To represent the center
b) To implement the decisions of the Executive Board and manage the Center within the framework of
the relevant legislation
c) To determine the funding and staff needs of the Center and submit it to the Rector's approval
d) To carry out management, coordination, supervision and general supervision of the center staff
e) To submit the activity reports to the Rector's approval after obtaining the op inion of the Executive
Board
f) To implement the work program in accordance with the decisions of the Executive Board and to
ensure the regular operation of the Center
g) To carry out the administrative and financial affairs of the Center, to change personnel and duties
between units when deemed necessary, by taking the opinion of the Executive Board
h) To carry out appropriate projects and mutual assistance by cooperating with domestic and
international application and research centers
i) To prepare a report on the training, applications, and research activities of the Center within two
months following the end of each calendar year and to submit this activity report to the higher authority with
which the Center is affiliated, by taking the opinion of the Executive Board
Duties of Deputy Directors
ARTICLE 10 – (1) The duties of the deputy directors are as follows:
a) To assist the Director in the management and operation of the center
b) To carry out the duties determined by the Director

c) To represent the Director when necessary
d) To carry out the coordination of the activities of the Center and to prepare reports, particularly annual
activity reports, related to the Center
Executive Board
ARTICLE 11 – (1) Executive Board consists of seven members in total, under the chair personship of
the Director, six of whom are assigned by the Rector for a term of three years upon the recommendation of
the Director, from among the faculty members working at the University related to the fields of activity of the
Center. A new member is assigned using the same procedure to replace a member who leaves before the end
of his/her term of office, takes leave for more than six months, or is assigned outside the University.
(2) Executive Board meets once every three months, upon the call of the director, by absolute majority.
Decisions are taken by majority vote of those attending the meeting. In case of equality of votes, the decision
is taken in favor of the Director's vote.
Duties of the Executive Board
ARTICLE 12 – (1) The duties of the Executive Board are as follows:
a) To decide on the scientific research, consultancy , and publication activities of the Center and the
principles regarding these activities
b) To ensure the preparation and implementation of plans and programs regarding the work of the center
c) To prepare the investment and plan draft of the center and submit it to the Rector for approval
d) To establish temporary working groups regarding the activities of the Center when necessa ry and to
regulate their duties
e) To determine the basic principles, principles , and procedures of the studies to be carried out jointly
with public and private organizations at home and abroad
f) To approve and supervise the director’s work plan
g) To evaluate and decide on the issues brought by the Director regarding the management of the Center
h) To indicate the name and project number of the Center in any publication made at or supported by
the Center and deliver a copy of the said publication to the Center
i) To develop methods for the use, sharing, and programming of resources, tools, and time by researchers
and to make decisions about these methods
j) To plan and carry out all kinds of training activities to be carried out within the center and to review
the final report
k) To determine the principles of researcher and patent rights regarding the applications and research
offered and supported on behalf of the Center, and the distribution, and use of income in accordance with the
relevant legislation
l) To decide on work-related assignments
m) To decide together with the Director on the determination of the units to be located in the center and
the recruitment or assignment of personnel to work in these units
Advisory Board
ARTICLE 12/A - (1) Advisory Board consists of a minimum of five and a maximum of thirty
members, assigned by the Rector for a term of three years, upon the recommendation of the Executive Board,
from among the directors and deputy directors, and persons within and outside the University who are directly
involved in scientific and technological research and applications and whose knowledge and experience may
be benefited from. The Advisory Board meets at least once a year under the chairpersonship of the Director.
Duties of the Advisory Board
ARTICLE 12/B - (1) The duties of the Advisory Board are as follows:

a) To present all kinds of suggestions regarding the functions of the Center in increasing the scientific
and technological potential of the University in smart agricultural technologies, and to express opinions on
the measures to be taken and the applications to be carried out
b) To express opinions that will contribute to the creation and development of a cooperation
environment with industrial organizations and other scientific and technological organizations in the region
c) To express opinions on the evaluation of non -university financial resources and to develop
suggestions for initiatives in this direction
d) To enable the opinions and thoughts of experts regarding the objectives and areas of activity of the
center to be received
e) To provide opinions and suggestions on ensuring cooperation and coordination between centers
affiliated with other universities, the industry, and relevant public institutions in order to facilitate the national
and international connections of the center
SECTION FOUR
Miscellaneous and Final Provisions
Spending Authority
ARTICLE 13 – Repealed.
Staff Need
ARTICLE 14 – (1) The academic, technical , and administrative staff needs of the Center are met by
the personnel assigned by the Rector in accordance with Article 13 of Law No. 2547.
Cases Without Provision
ARTICLE 15 – (1) In cases where there is no provision in this Regulation, Law No. 2547, other relevant
legislative provisions, and Senate decisions shall apply.
Enforcement
ARTICLE 16 – (1) This Regulation shall enter into force on the date it is released.
Execution
ARTICLE 17 – (1) The provisions of this Regulation shall be executed by the Rector of Gebze
Technical University.
